SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', crawl_date) AS month,
    SUM(open_listings) AS total_open_listings
  FROM
    mart_daily_market
  WHERE
    family = 'AI'
    AND crawl_date >= '2026-06-01'
  GROUP BY
    month
  ORDER BY
    month
